title: Review of c41's CIPS propulsion negative: replicated on seed 3; stronger drift (chi 4.5 and 6) nucleates 30-41 bodies at once into a frozen lattice with 0 divisions and at most 2.1 labkit body lengths of motion
summary: World copied unchanged; labkit seed 3, 192^2, t=10000. chi 4.5: 30 nucleations, 30 bodies at the end, 0 splits, max 1.9 body lengths (sqrt(area)), max speed 0.0020/t. chi 6: 41 nucleations, 40 bodies, 0 persistent splits (1 merge), max 2.1 body lengths, max speed 0.0022/t. The sheet (chi 6) shows round bodies fixed in a near-hexagonal lattice from t~1000 to 10000. Same as the finding's seed 0 (chi 4.5: 31 nucleations, 1.6; chi 6: 44, 2.1).

observations.finding: rerun/chi6_seed3/FACTS.md and rerun/chi45_seed3/FACTS.md: 41 and 30 nucleations, 0 persistent splits, max 2.1 and 1.9 body lengths; sheet t=1000-10000 a static lattice of round bodies

seeds_run.result: pass: dense nucleation, no motion >= 3 body lengths, no division, in both arms

verdicts.limitation: Two of the finding's eight arms (chi 4.5 and 6 at the default Dp and d), one new seed; the Dp 0.3 and raised-turnover arms were not re-run. Motion measured with labkit's sqrt(area) screen, which is the right unit for round bodies' diameter within ~12%.
